title: Vista Phase 4 follow-ups
intro: Zoom and pan in the Timing window, and a close button on every Point-window selection.
Answers save in this browser as you go. Hit Download results at the end and send me the file.

steps.text: Run `make build`, then reload Vista in `/xlplugins` -> Dev Tools.
Mode -> Edit. Build a track of ten or more points with the first few close together, like your screenshot. Open the Timing window with the chart icon.

groups.title: Zoom and fit
groups.need: The wheel zooms time around the cursor; the distance axis fits whatever is in view, so crowded keys spread both ways.

steps.action: Hover over the crowded early keys and scroll up
steps.expect: The graph zooms in and the time under the cursor stays under it.

steps.action: Keep scrolling up
steps.expect: The crowded keys spread apart sideways and vertically until each can be picked out.

steps.action: Keep scrolling up well past that
steps.expect: It stops at about a fifth of a second across.

steps.action: Look at the time labels along the bottom
steps.expect: They switch to decimals as you zoom and never overlap.

steps.action: Look at the yalm labels and the plot's right edge while zooming
steps.expect: Labels update; the plot does not shift sideways.

steps.action: Look at the point numbers on the left
steps.expect: Only points in view are listed.

steps.action: Scroll down
steps.expect: It zooms out and stops at the whole track.

steps.action: Look at the icon at the top right of the Timing window, zoomed and not
steps.expect: Enabled while zoomed, greyed out at the whole track.

steps.action: Zoom in, then click it
steps.expect: Back to the whole track.

steps.action: Zoom in, then switch the edited track
steps.expect: The new track shows whole.

steps.action: Scroll over the Timing window
steps.expect: Fly speed does not change, and the window itself does not scroll.

steps.action: Zoomed in, drag on empty graph space
steps.expect: The view slides with the mouse.

steps.action: Drag it hard both ways
steps.expect: It stops at the start and the end of the track.

steps.action: At the whole track, drag on empty space
steps.expect: Nothing happens.

steps.action: Zoomed, drag a key
steps.expect: The key moves, the view does not.

steps.action: Zoomed, click the curve between keys
steps.expect: The leg selects, as before.

steps.action: Zoomed, drag in the strip under the plot
steps.expect: It scrubs within the view, as before.

groups.title: Editing while zoomed
groups.need: Dragging the last key past the plot's right edge lengthens the shot. That used to assume the whole shot filled the plot, and a zoomed drag would have jumped; it now carries on at the view's scale.

steps.action: Zoom onto the last few keys and drag the last key past the right edge
steps.expect: The track lengthens smoothly with the mouse. No jump.

steps.action: Zoomed, Ctrl + drag a middle key
steps.expect: The ripple still carries the later keys.

steps.action: Zoomed, select a key with handles and drag a handle
steps.expect: The handle and the curve respond as they do unzoomed.

steps.action: Scrub the playhead out of view, then back
steps.expect: The orange line disappears while out of view and returns.

steps.action: Add a hold and zoom inside it
steps.expect: A flat line across the middle. No error.

steps.action: At the whole track, compare the time labels with before
steps.expect: Tracks of 8-16 s keep 1 s labels; shorter ones get half-seconds, 16-32 s get 2 s. Say if any of that reads worse.

steps.action: Select a point, click the X at the Point window's top right
steps.expect: The window closes and the point is deselected.

steps.action: Select a Look At point, click the X
steps.expect: Same.

steps.action: Select a point, switch to View and back to Edit
steps.expect: Still selected; only the X deselects.
